reviews.comment:
Es un ícono poder contar con este ACA para reabastecimiento en el tramo San Luis-San Juan.
El playero muy atento.
Si hay algo que debería criticar es la prohibición de consumir dentro del local y la baja calidad de los sandwiches de miga que son eso precisamente....pura miga y nada de fiambre, algo totalmente contrario al standard al que estamos acostumbrados los socios

(Translated by Google)
It's a real plus to have this ACA (Automobile Club of Argentina) station for refueling on the San Luis-San Juan stretch.
The attendant was very helpful. If there's anything I should criticize, it's the prohibition on eating inside and the poor quality of the "sandwiches de miga" (crustless sandwiches), which are exactly that...pure crumbs and no cold cuts, completely contrary to the standard we members are used to.
